# Shalom Park — Instagram keyword rules

*Generated from `keywords.csv` by `tools/build-keywords.js`. **Do not edit this file** — edit the CSV and rebuild. 27 rules, 356 trigger phrases.*

> **How to read this.** A buyer comments or DMs. If their words hit a trigger, they get exactly the text in "What the buyer is sent" — no AI involved, no chance of a wrong number. Anything that hits nothing goes to the Concierge brain instead.

## Notes on each rule

| Rule | Grounded in | Note |
|---|---|---|
| SP-ESC-ROI | must_not_say[0] · must_not_say[1] | NEVER give a figure. Zero facts by design. Narrowed 2026-09-15: general investment interest now goes to SP-INVEST, which answers with warranted facts. This rule keeps the projection asks - and still outranks SP-INVEST when both match. |
| SP-ESC-REFUND | payment.refund_policy.summary | Verbatim per kb assistant_handling. Never soften or omit the 25% or the resale condition. |
| SP-ESC-PAYTO | payment.account_name · payment.account_number_policy | States the account NAME (warranted) and never a number. Highest-trust moment in the whole flow. |
| SP-ESC-DISC | pricing_terms.negotiable · payment.initial_deposit · payment.plan_durations | Negotiability is warranted. No discount authority exists. |
| SP-ESC-LEGAL | documentation.litigation_acquisition_or_dispute · documentation.title_status | Conversational statement of a warranted fact is permitted. Documents not yet sighted by Propel - Gate 2. |
| SP-ESC-COMPLETE | development.overall_stage_percent · escalate_always[0] | estimated_completion_date is null in the KB. Escalation is the only correct answer. |
| SP-ESC-FEES | pricing_terms.included_in_price · pricing_terms.excluded_from_price · pricing_terms.excluded_amounts_supplied | Excluded ITEMS are warranted. Excluded AMOUNTS are not supplied - never estimate them. |
| SP-ESC-AGENT | escalate_always[9] | Commercial terms are never the assistants business. |
| SP-ESC-MORTGAGE | payment.initial_deposit · payment.plan_durations | No mortgage or financing arrangement exists anywhere in the facts sheet. |
| SP-2B | units[1].price_ngn · units[1].stage · units[1].available · units[1].total_units | PROMO LIVE (open-ended, re-confirm by 2026-10-15). 5,000,000 naira entry deposit per Collins 2026-09-15. Runs until sold out, so it carries a review date instead of an end date - if nobody re-confirms it, the card reverts to the signed 50% terms on its own. |
| SP-4B | units[0].price_ngn · units[0].available · units[0].finishing · pricing_terms.excluded_from_price · payment.initial_deposit | PROMO LIVE (open-ended, re-confirm by 2026-10-15). 70% deposit per Collins 2026-09-15, adopted on ADEDAMOLA's instruction. Noted for the record: 70% is higher than the signed 50%, so the assistant asks a buyer for more upfront, not less. Reverts to the signed 50% if the promo is not re-confirmed. |
| SP-5B | units[2].price_ngn · units[2].available · units[2].stage · payment.plan_durations | Escalates because handover_dates_supplied is false. Longest sales cycle - this is where the Concierge earns its fee. |
| SP-LAND | units[3].price_ngn_per_sqm · escalate_always[6] | Plot size 648 sqm supplied by Collins 2026-09-15, filling a blank the signed sheet left. At the warranted rate that implies about 81,000,000 naira a plot - the assistant states size and rate, never the multiplication, and never availability. |
| SP-PRICE-GEN | units[0].price_ngn · units[1].price_ngn · units[2].price_ngn · units[3].price_ngn_per_sqm · pricing_terms.excluded_from_price | All four products now carry a price. The 2-bed figure was released 2026-09-15 once Collins restated it. |
| SP-AVAIL | units[0].available · units[1].available · units[1].total_units · units[2].available · fact_maintenance.unit_count_update_frequency | Counts stated plainly with the re-check cadence. No scarcity language - CLAUDE.md rule 2. |
| SP-LOC | location.address · location.landmarks | Safest card in the set - no price no title. Good default for cold traffic. |
| SP-INSPECT | inspection.physical · inspection.meeting_point · inspection.virtual | Escalates because capabilities.booking is false - no calendar is wired yet. Turn escalate off when booking ships. |
| SP-VIRTUAL | inspection.virtual · inspection.diaspora_representative_allowed | Diaspora buyers are the highest-value segment and the most time-zone-hostile - this card exists for them. |
| SP-PAY | payment.initial_deposit · payment.plan_durations · payment.interest_or_markup | interest_or_markup is null. Any instalment arithmetic is an escalation until that field is filled. |
| SP-DOCS | documentation.title_status · documentation.layout_approval · delivery.documents_buyer_receives | PRIVATE REPLY ONLY. Title type may be stated conversationally but must never appear in a public comment - documents not yet sighted (Gate 2). |
| SP-AMEN | amenities.delivered | Everything listed is warranted as DELIVERED not planned. Never move an item from planned to delivered without a signed update. |
| SP-BUILD | delivery.building_restrictions | The 4-storey cap is the only building fact in the sheet. Everything else escalates. |
| SP-DELIV | delivery.allocation · delivery.documents_buyer_receives · delivery.handover_dates_supplied | handover_dates_supplied is false - always escalate the date. |
| SP-INFO | location.address · development.total_land_size · units | Lowest priority - the catch-all. Opens with AI disclosure because it is usually the first touch. |
| SP-ESC-PROMO | escalate_always[7] | PROMO LIVE (open-ended, re-confirm by 2026-10-15). Reverts to the neutral "let me check what is running" answer if the review lapses. |
| SP-DEVPLOT | developer.legal_name · escalate_always[6] | Parcel size supplied by Collins 2026-09-15. Deliberately NOT priced: bulk rates may differ from 125,000/sqm, and at this size the difference is hundreds of millions. |
| SP-INVEST | units[2].price_ngn · units[2].available · units[2].finishing · documentation.title_status · documentation.layout_approval · amenities.delivered · development.total_land_size · development.overall_stage_percent · location.landmarks | The INVESTMENT campaign, shipped 2026-09-15 on ADEDAMOLA's instruction. Makes the case entirely from warranted, DELIVERED facts - title, infrastructure on the ground, stage, access - and carries no projection, percentage, guarantee or claim that value will rise. Those stay with SP-ESC-ROI, which outranks this rule whenever both match. |
